versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g The associated Cross Software Cluster Communication Plug-In shall provide the Rte_Rips_Feedback Service for each VariableDataPrototype instance in an AbstractProvidedPortPrototype for which a VariableAccess of a RunnableEntity in the role dataSendPoint exists, if • for the related Data Communication Graph the Cross Software Clus- ter Communication Plug-In support is enabled AND • acknowledgement is enabled for a provided VariableDataPrototype by the existence of a TransmissionAcknowledgementRequest in the SenderCom- Spec In this case the name part [<SwcBswI>] exists.

Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00306, SRS_Rte_00300, SRS_Rte_00303 The associated Cross Software Cluster Communication Plug-In shall provide the Rte_Rips_Feedback Service for each VariableDataPrototype in- stance in an AbstractProvidedPortPrototype for which a VariableAccess of a RunnableEntity in the role dataSendPoint exists, if • for the related Data Communication Graph the Cross Software Clus- ter Communication Plug-In support is enabled AND • acknowledgement is enabled for a provided VariableDataPrototype by the existence of a TransmissionAcknowledgementRequest in the SenderCom- Spec AND • explicit queued communication applies to that VariableDataPrototype In this case the name part [<SwcBswI>] exists.
